comment: A fourth output, PITCH_SPREAD_OUTPUT, is declared at Palette.cpp:92 but the widget never adds a jack for it and process() never writes it, so it has no line and no tag. Two parameters share the panel position at 18,76: the engine attenuverter and the wavetable output mode knob, swapped by the widget's step() at Palette.cpp:800-803 according to whether the wavetable engine is running with the engine input unpatched. Both are tagged, because a hidden widget is skipped when a click is resolved and only the visible one can ever be reached. The source comment at Palette.cpp:499 says the trigger input fires at around 0.7V; the code divides by 3 at :502 and plaits fires above 0.3 at voice.cc:96, which is 0.9V at the jack. The octave knob is configured -4 to 4 at Palette.cpp:147 while the panel numbers its positions 0 to 8. The panel is a stack of sixteen SVGs, one per engine, drawn over a common background at Palette.cpp:831-836, so the lettering on the harmonics, timbre and morph knobs and on the two single outputs changes with the engine. configInput is called twice for the engine input, at Palette.cpp:213 with "Engine choice CV" and again at :223 with "Engine CV"; the second wins, and the census carries the second. The low pass gate is bypassed at voice.cc:221-222 unless the level or trigger input is patched. addParam is called twice for the output mix knob at Palette.cpp:858-859, putting two widgets at the same place for the same parameter, which is harmless.
